authorityBoundary: Computing-only read of historical E0 evidence; no equipment install/remove or owner source mutation.
budget: DeepSeek V4 Flash and V4 Pro; two replicas per 8 cases x 3 treatments x 2 models = 96 logical slots; identical max output and no-tool Harness budgets.
deletionOrNoChangeOutcome: If calibrated procedure does not improve cross-model decision quality over both RAW and STATIC, do not generalize meta-selection calibration as a PAL mechanism.
developmentSplit: targeted mutation testing, Firefox/WebKit, TShark, mitmproxy.
evidenceSelection: Eight E0 professional-equipment cases whose final dispositions are frozen by the E0 closeout. Provider-visible packets contain treatment evidence but not the final disposition sentence/table.
invalidityConditions: CALIBRATED text changes after first call
invalid structured output scored as semantic error
case/replica count changes after seeing results
minimalCandidateOrNoChange: STATIC: same compact Infrastructure Promotion Rule used in F5. CALIBRATED: a general evidence-calibration procedure requiring explicit consideration of current consumer, incremental outcome, simpler baseline, recurring cost/coupling, authority fit, and reopen/deletion before choosing; it does not specify which disposition those facts imply in any case.
mission: Test whether evidence-calibrated meta-selection transfers better than a static promotion prior or raw strong-model judgment into a materially different equipment-retention decision world.
publicationBoundary: A positive result remains a Computing PAL hypothesis requiring another prospective decision family before Knowledge/Core promotion.
questionOrHypothesis: Is reusable meta-selection value carried by a static rule, or by a calibration procedure that explicitly balances current consumer, incremental outcome, simpler baseline, recurring cost, authority fit and reopen/deletion evidence?
stopRule: Stop after all 96 slots are durably retained as valid or invalid. Compare exact disposition, over-retention, under-retention, model-family interaction and token cost. No V2 calibration tuning in this campaign.
strongBaseline: RAW: generic evidence-first, complexity-sensitive decision with no retained meta prior.
